pages.text: The cushion is the earliest cultivation tool. Once a player equips any technique, even while still Mortal, nearby Qi particles can be absorbed automatically; sitting on the cushion improves Cultivation Efficiency. Qi-gathering arrays and qi-producing blocks improve Qi particle generation and block-Qi recovery.
Cultivation depends on the whole environment, not only the cushion. Spirit vein cores, rune conduits, qi-gathering arrays, and qi block specs turn a base into a proper cultivation cave.
